en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5903 - Hammad ibn Uthman narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
"In the wisdom of the family of Dawud (as), it is fitting for a wise person to be focused on his own affairs, to safeguard his tongue, and to be aware of the people of his time."
